title: Accelerated Development Program (E-Commerce, Thailand) - 2027 Start

reasons.love: The rotational e-commerce programme covers category growth and seller development, directly matching his preferred commercial roles.
reasons.good_at: F10 and F21 support seller and partnership work, F31 and F26 show analytical work, and F20 and F25 show leadership and communication in a student-run company.
reasons.needs: The posting offers structured rotations across category growth, seller development and operations at an established e-commerce platform.
reasons.paid: estimate, THB 30,000-50,000 per month -> about THB 40,000/month. Estimated gross monthly range for a Bangkok e-commerce graduate programme; the posting states no salary.

summary: Strong commercial and timing fit; the main risk is the competitive multi-stage selection process.
jd_text: Bachelor/Master Graduate - 2027 Start. The Accelerated Development Program (ADP) is a rotational programme for 2027 graduates joining TikTok Shop Thailand e-commerce. Rotations cover category growth, seller development and operations. Programme starts June 2027 in Bangkok. Requirements: bachelor's or master's degree graduating in 2027; strong analytical and communication skills; leadership experience; fluent Thai and English. Selection: online test, HR interview, case day, leaders interview. Applications close 30 November 2026 or earlier when full.
